name: Nuxeo Web UI
install: cp -n .env.sample .env || true; npm install && npm run pretest

terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.description: Webpack dev server for Nuxeo Web UI on http://localhost:5000. Proxies /nuxeo to NUXEO_HOST (default localhost:8080); backend API calls fail with 504 until a Nuxeo server is available, but the SPA builds and serves.
